title: QA_Platform_create_rejects_unknown_status
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only status.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 (a typed refusal) — never a 500. The status is cast straight into the EventGroup enum (app/services/event_groups/create_service.rb:36), so an unknown value raises ArgumentError unless it is caught.
rationale: status is an enum; an unknown value is the most common client typo. An untyped 500 here means every bad status crashes the endpoint.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_status_withdrawn_does_not_crash
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only status.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx. "withdrawn" is a valid EventGroup status but NOT a line-item status (app/models/event_group_line_item.rb:28), and create copies the status onto the line items (app/services/event_groups/create_service.rb:36).
rationale: A value valid for the parent but not the child enum is exactly where copy-down code crashes.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_status_as_number_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only status.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx; ideally 422. Rails enums accept an integer index, so 1 may silently mean "active" — creating a live event from a draft request.
rationale: Wrong type for an enum: a number can be accepted as a hidden index and skip the draft stage.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_blank_status_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only status.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 "Insufficient parameters" — app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:25 checks params[:status].blank?
rationale: Blank string is the empty form field case; must be treated like a missing status.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_boq_flag_string_false_is_not_boq
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only config.boq_based_rfx.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: HTTP 2xx and a normal (non-BOQ) draft. The controller reads params.dig('config','boq_based_rfx') || false (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:28): the STRING "false" is truthy in Ruby, so where BOQ is not allowed it answers 101 "You are not allowed to perform this action" — a coercion defect.
rationale: Boolean sent as text is common from form posts and scripts; truthy-string handling silently flips the event type.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_boq_flag_zero_is_not_boq
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only config.boq_based_rfx.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: HTTP 2xx and a normal draft. 0 is truthy in Ruby, so app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:28 treats it as BOQ ON → 101 where the workspace forbids BOQ.
rationale: 0/1 flags are standard in other stacks; Ruby's truthiness makes 0 mean ON.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_config_as_array_does_not_crash
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only config.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx. params.dig on an array config raises TypeError in app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:28.
rationale: Wrong container type (array for object) is a classic unguarded dig.

title: QA_Platform_create_line_item_without_quality_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only line_items[].product_quality_uuid.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: A typed 422, never a 500. The quality is looked up and used without a nil check (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6300-6302).
rationale: A missing required id inside a nested item is the most likely nil-dereference in create.

title: QA_Platform_create_line_item_without_product_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only line_items[].product_uuid.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: A typed 422, never a 500 — product lookup is not nil-guarded (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6291-6302).
rationale: Missing parent id in a nested item.

title: QA_Platform_create_line_item_with_null_quantity_is_refused
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only line_items[].quantity.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: A typed 422 (quantity is required), never a 500.
rationale: null where an object is expected — reading .value off nil.

title: QA_Platform_create_line_item_with_unknown_unit_does_not_crash
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only line_items[].quantity.unitSymbol.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx; ideally 422 "unknown unit". An unknown unit stored as-is breaks every later conversion.
rationale: Free-text into what the UI treats as a unit list.

title: QA_Platform_create_line_item_with_decimal_quantity_for_nos
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only line_items[].quantity.value.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx. A count unit ("Nos") with a fractional value should be refused or rounded explicitly — not stored as 10.5 pieces.
rationale: Decimal where the unit implies an integer.

title: QA_Platform_create_line_item_with_huge_quantity
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only line_items[].quantity.value.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx — a numeric overflow on the decimal column should be a 422, not a database error.
rationale: Over column precision: the database raises, not the model.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_same_product_twice
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only line_items.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx. Either both lines are kept with serial numbers 1 and 2, or the duplicate is refused with a clear code — never a uniqueness crash.
rationale: Duplicate entries in a list.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_line_item_as_string
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only line_items[].
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: A typed 422, never a 500 (string where a line-item object is expected; app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6291 indexes into it).
rationale: Wrong element type inside the list.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_attachments_as_string_does_not_orphan
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only attachments.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx. Attachments as a string reach the serializer AFTER the commit (app/models/event_group.rb:333), so a 500 here leaves an orphan draft behind.
rationale: A crash after commit is worse than before: the client sees failure, the database kept the record.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_attachments_array_of_strings
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only attachments[].
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx (same path as above, event_group.rb:333).
rationale: Array of the wrong element type.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_whitespace_title
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only title.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx; ideally 422 or a trimmed default title — a blank-looking event in every list is a UX defect.
rationale: Whitespace-only passes a blank? check in some code paths and not others.

title: QA_Platform_create_with_numeric_description
preconditions: A buyer session; a product and quality from the company's catalog.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a working draft body, changing only description.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx — a number where text is expected should be stored as text or refused.
rationale: Type mismatch in a free-text field.

title: QA_Platform_patch_with_only_title_changes_title
preconditions: A sandbox copy of an event built by the platform ({{eventGroupUuid}}), published.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} changing only title.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: HTTP 2xx and the title really changes. Code note: a PATCH carrying only title answers 200 without applying it (app/controllers/concerns/event_group_controller_helper.rb:29-36) — a silent no-op the client cannot detect.
rationale: A success response for a change that was not made hides the bug from every client.

title: QA_Platform_patch_with_unknown_status_is_refused
preconditions: A sandbox copy of an event built by the platform ({{eventGroupUuid}}), published.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} changing only status.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: A typed 422, never a 500 (enum cast on update, app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb).
rationale: Unknown enum on the update path.

title: QA_Platform_patch_back_to_draft_after_publish
preconditions: A sandbox copy of an event built by the platform ({{eventGroupUuid}}), published.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} changing only status.
2. Read the status code and error.
expectedResult: No 5xx; a published event should not silently go back to draft — expect a refusal or no change.
rationale: Wrong-order state transition (active → draft).
